Surat & Mumbai: India's gold imports fell 81.27% in September to $1.8 billion, Commerce Ministry data show. The duty has stood at 15% (up from 6%) since 13 May; PM Modi has urged buyers to defer purchases. Six-month imports are down 27.32% to $19.27bn.

સુરત માટે: ભારતની સોનાની આયાત સપ્ટેમ્બરમાં 81.27% ઘટીને $1.8 અબજ થઈ.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio. Source: Commerce Ministry via Kotak Neo, 16 Oct.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs12,529/g, silver Rs1,73,857/kg -- 21 Oct tape, USD/INR 94.59.
